param_input_item.param_description: a string: terminal title. The default title is Terminal.
a string: docked creates a terminal docked in the main Nelson window, and normal creates a floating terminal window. The default value is docked.
a string: shell executable to start. If empty, Nelson uses the platform default shell: %COMSPEC% with cmd.exe fallback on Windows, and $SHELL with /bin/sh fallback on Linux and macOS.
a string: terminal color theme. Supported values are auto, light, and dark. The default value is auto.
a string: command sent to the shell after it starts. The default value is an empty string.

description.p: terminal opens a shell process in the Nelson GUI and returns a handle object.
The terminal object supports Name, Shell, Place, WindowStyle, Running, ExitCode, ProcessId, and Theme properties.

tr.td: Terminal title. This property can be changed after creation.
docked creates a terminal docked in the main Nelson window. normal creates a floating terminal window.
If empty, Nelson uses %COMSPEC% with cmd.exe fallback on Windows, and $SHELL with /bin/sh fallback on Linux and macOS.
Terminal color theme. This property can be changed after creation.
Command sent to the shell after it starts.

description.p: The Name and Theme properties can be changed after creation. The other terminal state properties are read-only.
The Place property returns nelson in this release.
